_scope: Octane, R5Flowstate S21 client / S3 dedi, 120 fps, lane C; sessions M4b_octane (m4b_pad_* only) + M4b_octane2; values computed by pad_rejump_analysis.py

noinput.landing_f0.source: observed post/pre |h| on the landing cmd; OCTANE model clamp(1.996467 - 1.6714e-6 vz^2, 0, 1) = 0.24207

noinput.ground_decel_before_jump.source: observed on the 3 ground cmds (not x msc)

noinput.jump_cap_rule.source: observed post - prediction on the jump cmd

noinput.rejump_height_frac.source: observed V^2/(2 g 56); M2 multi-jump rule gives 0.3

noinput.msc_after_hop_landing.source: observed: the soft hop landing replaces the slowdown (f0 = 1)
